verdict.rationale: Cognee's first-party docs state it is open source and can run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack for free (cognee-docs-14). They also give a single-command Docker quick start, `docker run ... cognee/cognee:main`, for custom deployments (cognee-docs-7, cognee-docs-26, cognee-docs-36). The UI, all pipelines and even an offline, no-API-key demo can run entirely on your own machine without an account (cognee-docs-10, cognee-docs-44). Missing for 10: production-grade self-hosting guidance (docker-compose/Kubernetes, configuring backing graph/vector/relational stores, scaling), explicit license details, and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
